summary: Tenax Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing a temporary pause in enrollment for its Phase 3 LEVEL-2 trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF to amend enrollment criteria based on completed LEVEL trial learnings; enrollment may resume per site as the amended protocol takes effect. The company also requested a Type C FDA meeting on levosimendan development and updated its investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1). No financial terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. Watch regulatory feedback, protocol amendment timing, and any resulting financing needs.
